info.name: BFF Elearning integration tests
info.description: MAIR-262: working checks (the BFF starts, resolves sessions against Core API, reaches the E-learning API) and the enrolment and progression journey the fronts rely on, replayed by newman on docker-compose-integration.yml (./integration_test.sh). The seeded Admin (user 1) and agent (user 2) are impersonated with EdDSA JWTs signed by integration_test.sh with the run's key, like Core signs them (MAIR-680); both are enrolled in the seeded course 4 (chapter 11, content 27), whose progress init-test.sql resets on every run. The E-learning API publishes no operation to create, update, delete or rate a course yet: the BFF answers 501 on those routes after the validation and the administrator check, and the collection pins that behaviour until the upstream supports them.

exec: // One fresh account per run so the collection is replayable against a persistent database.
// MAIR-680: Core alone signs the session JWTs (EdDSA) and the BFF only holds its public key. The
// seeded accounts have no known password and the Postman sandbox cannot sign EdDSA, so their JWTs
// (jwt_admin, jwt_agent, and jwt_forged: Core's kid, another key) are signed by integration_test.sh
// with the run's key and injected by docker-compose-integration.yml. This script only forges
// jwt_hs256: an HS256 token for the Admin signed with a random secret, which must be refused.
const hsPayload = b64url(cryptoJs.enc.Utf8.parse(JSON.stringify({ sub: String(pm.environment.get('admin_user_id')), role: 'admin', exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600 })));
